title: dryopteris filix-mas subsp. borreri
intro: Dryopteris filix-mas subsp. borreri, commonly known as the Mountain Male Fern, is a subspecies of the Male Fern plant. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris filix-mas subsp. borreri include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
